summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). Built and validated robot manipulation systems on real hardware: a voice-controlled pick-and-place arm with 10/10 pick reliability after root-causing 11 integration failures, and collision-free motion planning with MoveIt on a physical UR5e. Write Python daily on Linux, from ROS 2 arm drivers to systemd-deployed Jetson services.

Linux & Deployment: systemd service management (unit files, auto-restart, non-root isolation)

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and AI/ML integration end-to-end.
Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place motion plans on a physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver; measured AL5B repeatability at <2mm over 10 trials.
Derived DH tables and hand-computed full forward kinematic chains (0T6) for a 6-DoF UR5e and a 5-DoF AL5B; validated against MoveIt and RViz URDF simulation models in ROS 2 Humble and ROS Noetic.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end voice-to-picked latency.
Built a vision-guided pick-and-place system: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO edge server, and Jetson+Arduino controller linked by a unified WebSocket fabric.
Integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms) for visual servoing and gripper ToF sensing (close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping; implemented two-link IK on Arduino in C++.
Deployed the Jetson-side arm bridge as a systemd service (auto-restart with backoff, non-root isolation) with static IP networking for reliable multi-device registration.

projects.name: Robocon Competition Robot — Holonomic Drive & Encoder Odometry
bullets: Built closed-loop heading correction for a 4-wheel holonomic robot on Arduino Due using dual-axis quadrature encoder odometry (2400 CPR); drove four motor channels at 15 kHz PWM.
Added a fail-safe state machine halting all motors on controller disconnect; led the coding team to Stage 3 of DD Robocon 2023, scoring 99/100 in Stage 1.
